title: Battle of Doliana
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Doliana", at revision 1370109805, opens: "The Battle of Doliana occurred on 30 May 1821 N.S. during the Greek War of Independence when Greek revolutionaries defeated the forces of the Ottoman Empire at Doliana in the Morea province of the Ottoman Empire." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2579514, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1821 battle that occurred during the Greek War of Independence". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
